description: Sets the stocked quantity of an item at a location. Provide either an absolute 'stocked_quantity' or a relative 'adjust_by' (+/-). Identify the item by inventory_item_id or SKU. Without location_id the item's only location is used. If the item is not stocked at the given location yet, it is added there.

adjust_by.description: E.g. +10 when restocking, -2 when writing off

name: set_stock_level
title: Set stock level
